notes: The size Crisp promises on the card is now the size of the file it writes. On clips whose pixels are very slightly non-square — which is what an ordinary 854x480 16:9 encode is — the plan said 2558x1440 and the export came out 2562x1440, because the part that describes the job and the part that renders it disagreed about when to treat pixels as square. They now ask the same question of the same code.
